title: TTF Holds Above €31 as NBP Spikes on Front-Month Squeeze; HH Steady Post-Storm Normalisation
edito: TTF holds €31.55 as EU storage scrapes 30.9% — a 10pp YoY deficit and the lowest late-Feb reading since 2022. Record LNG arrivals (14.2 Mt) meet depleted Norwegian hydro, an April 25 Russian LNG ban, and Hormuz drills. EUA crashes 23% on Merz ETS bombshell. The refill math barely works — if it doesn't, Q3 reprices violently.

title: HH March Settles Below $3 as EIA Draw Fails to Inspire — TTF Holds €31.88
edito: HH breaks below $3 on a yawn-inducing EIA print while EU storage scrapes multi-year lows at 33%. The market is sleepwalking into refill season — record LNG arrivals mask a structural deficit that one March cold snap could expose. Watch the tails, not the base case.

title: Europe's 90% Storage Mandate Meets 34% Reality — The Refill Equation Tightens
edito: TTF cracks €30 for the first time since January as an LNG cargo wave meets collapsing EUA carbon — yet EU storage at 32.5% is the lowest mid-February reading in 8 years. Mukran ice-locked, Golden Pass ramping, Arctic LNG 2 sanctions leaking: the market is pricing a perfect spring while sitting on the thinnest cushion since 2022.

title: TTF Slides to 5-Week Low; HH Breaks Below $3.10 on Warm Forecasts
edito: Gas markets are pricing a premature spring while sitting on the thinnest storage cushion since 2022. The polar vortex disruption entering monitoring this week and the 67-day countdown to the EU Russian LNG ban suggest the downside from here is limited — but the upside tail risk is severe.

title: TTF Gaps to €30.67 on Monday Open — HH Breaks $3 for First Time Since October
edito: TTF gaps 5.6% lower to €30.67 as HH breaks $3 — the market is pricing spring while storage sits at 34%. This week's polar vortex window and Thursday's EIA report will determine whether this is capitulation or a bear trap.

title: TTF Holds €31.67 Into Week — HH Steady at $3.24 as Markets Digest EIA Outlook
edito: Storage anxiety meets vortex risk on the last stretch of winter. EU inventories at 4-year lows and a stratospheric disruption flagged for late February create an asymmetrically bullish setup — but the Merz ETS bombshell and record LNG arrivals keep the lid on for now. Geneva talks today add a wildcard.
